2.title: My first half Marathon
2.content: Ran my first half marathon this year. Thanks to Inida Hikes who got me interested in running when they asked for a proof of fitness before dec 2023 hike. Hope to run a marathon in this lifetime. FinishCanadaArmyRun2025 .

3.title: Portuguese Central Camino
3.content: Portuguese Central Camino 10 days, 250 km — from Porto to Santiago de Compostela. Started on October 13 in Porto and arrived on the afternoon of October 22 in Santiago. What a journey. The joy I experienced is beyond words. If St. James wills it, I’m already preparing — in spirit — for the Frances route. CaminoPortugueseCentral2025 .

5.title: About Me
5.content: Sharing some moments on my path —a space to document my travels, thoughts, and inner explorations. Helps me take a pause and dewell on these experiences. If you’re reading this, thank you for being part of the journey.
